 D/L 38

 S.Kundu C.R.M.(A) 1696 of 2025
 Rejected
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under
 section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
 2023/under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
 In connection with Gr case no. 2715 of 2023 arising out of

police station case no. 567 dated 2.9.2023
 registered for investigation into offences punishable under
Section 341/323/325/354/376/506/511/34 of the Ipc.

In the matter of: Sk. Saharul Islam
 ... Petitioner
 Mr. Nazir Ahmed
 ...for the petitioner.

Mr. Bhsakar ch. Manna
 Mr. Biswajit Manna
 ...for the victim.
 Mr. Sanjoy Bardhan
 Ms. Manasi Roy
 ...for the State.

1 . 
Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that there is a prior civil dispute between the private parties.
In fact, the present case also refers to such dispute.
The petitioner is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated.

2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the de-facto complainant strongly opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and submits that it was he who had attempted to sexually assault the victim.

3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State refers to the injury report, the statement of the victim recorded before the Magistrate as also the statement of independent local witnesses present at pages 15, 16 and 56 of the case diary.
